d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Maintenance professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As Ken Fix It you are responsible for the general maintenance work on a daily basis.
q: You should ideally have a diploma or training in general maintenance works and previous experience within the plumbing, carpentry, painting or electrical field. A good command of English and the ability to find fault and rectify systems are essential.
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated with a hands-on and flexible approach and be able to adapt to unpredictable events.
You must be proactive and reliable and will thrive working in a busy environment and stay calm under pressure, have strong attention to detail and should possess the following competencies
r: Repair or replace all types of tiles, floor and wall as and when required
Carry out general repairs to block work walls
Carry out plaster repair works to walls
Repair and fix damaged shelving and furniture when necessary
Carry out general painting works as required
Carry out general plumbing, repairs and silicon sealant replacement, etc.
Repair and replace broken windows, doors and locks
Adhere to Rotana policies and procedures
Report any severe damages to the attention of your Superiors

d: The Logistics Officer is accountable for overseeing the inbound and outbound operations and inventory management. S/He maintains communication with carriers, suppliers, warehouses, custom brokers and others involved in the shipping and delivery of goods.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or any other related field
r: Control the reception of merchandise to the warehouse and follow up on inventory levels and damaged goods if any; perform purchase transaction and share forwarder invoices with finance team.
Manage outbound activities for customer orders;
Manage outbound shipments, follow up with clearing and forwarding agents and monitor the turnaround time (TAT);
Coordinate and arrange transportation of shipments to destination;
Track shipments and update customers on a timely basis;
Cooperate with the service and warehouse teams for smooth execution of shipments;
Coordinate with clearing agents and customs to maximize efficiency in terms of time and quality;
Verify customs documentations for exports and transfer of ownership;
Manage the stock movement through the warehouse management system and ERP;
Perform monthly stock audits; timely transactions in ERP and CRM
Coordinate with the planning, finance, service and credit teams for invoicing customer orders;

d: Kaizen Asset Management Services is seeking a dedicated and organized Mobilization Coordinator to oversee and facilitate the preparation and deployment of our project teams and resources. The Mobilization Coordinator plays a crucial role in ensuring that all necessary logistical, regulatory, and administrative steps are taken for operational readiness before project commencement.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in project coordination or mobilization roles, preferably in asset management or construction industries.
Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with a keen eye for detail.
With National Book and Emirati Passport
Must be willing to work in Dubai
Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.
Proficient in project management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines while maintaining quality.
Flexibility to travel as necessary to project sites and locations.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
Familiarity with compliance regulations and safety standards in the asset management or construction sectors is a plus.
r: Coordinate the mobilization process for project teams, ensuring all personnel, materials, and equipment are in place for project launch.
Develop and maintain detailed mobilization schedules and action plans, tracking progress and addressing any issues swiftly.
Collaborate with various departments and stakeholders to gather relevant information and logistics necessary for successful mobilization.
Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, safety standards, and project requirements, conducting risk assessments as necessary.
Communicate effectively with team members and project leaders to provide updates on mobilization status, challenges, and solutions.
Assist with onboarding and training of project personnel, ensuring they possess the necessary skills and knowledge to meet project requirements.
Support procurement efforts for necessary materials and equipment while maintaining budgetary constraints.
Document mobilization processes and improvements to enhance future coordination efforts.
Timeliness of the mobilization process and adherence to project timelines.
Accuracy and completeness of logistics and personnel deployment.
Stakeholder satisfaction regarding coordination and communication throughout the mobilization phase.
Compliance with safety and regulatory standards during mobilization activities.

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest-focused Revenue professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.

As a Reservations Agent, you are responsible for handling and maintaining effective communication regarding all reservations to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery. The ideal candidate must be fluent in both Arabic and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.
q: You should hold a diploma in Hospitality Management or a related field, with previous experience in hotel reservations, preferably within the hospitality industry.

You must be fluent in both written and spoken Arabic and English, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy and proficiency in hotel reservation systems are essential, while knowledge of additional languages will be considered an advantage.
The ideal candidate will be customer-focused, with a highly proactive personality and a courteous, dynamic and approachable manner.

You should demonstrate professionalism, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with both internal and external customers. You must also be capable of working independently within a structured environment while demonstrating the following competencies:
r: Process and confirm guest room reservations made by clients via telephone, email, letters or other communication channels.
Input all reservations into the computer system, ensuring that all pertinent information is accurately recorded, and attend to inquiries, complaints and requests related to reservations.
Remain up to date with all hotel promotions and offers, and follow established procedures for processing room reservations, rates, confirmations and hotel facilities.
Demonstrate comprehensive product knowledge, understand the hotel's rate structure and effectively apply rate management strategies.
Maintain an organized filing system for all correspondence and prepare reports as required by the Reservations Manager or Supervisor.
Promote and maintain positive public relations while actively seeking opportunities to maximize business.
Maintain accurate room availability and status at all times.
Ensure all incoming calls are answered in accordance with Rotana standards, process reservation requests received by fax and regularly monitor incoming emails.
Coordinate visa requests for hotel guests in accordance with hotel policies and actively upsell whenever opportunities arise.

d: The Senior Account Manager is accountable for managing a portfolio of accounts and promoting the company and its respective products/services through well-defined account management strategies and sound partnerships with existing/potential customers. S/He works towards optimizing sales volumes and champions marketing programs and activities in line with the Territory Sales Manager.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Sales and Marketing or any other related field.
At least 7 years of relevant experience.
r: Prepare and implement the account strategies and roadmap of the assigned portfolio in coordination and alignment with the management team
Develop and deliver accurate sales forecasts and targets in line with business objectives
Lead the vendors’ relations in alignment with the company’s management and strategy
Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing channels/clients to expand sales and establish new opportunities
Build and maintain a solid channel/customer database, analyze data and develop metrics evaluating loyalty and new opportunities
Specify market requirements for current and future products by conducting market research supported by on-going visits to existing and potential customers
Oversee the entire sales cycle from quotation to collection
Assess credit and/or payment performance, review outstanding settlements and audit resolutions accordingly
Ensure a proper storage, tracking and control of inventory through an accurate stock management system
Generate sales for the entire portfolio of accounts in terms of long-term revenue and profitability
Secure the highest level of engagement and support to Channel partners and respond to issues and/or queries in order to efficiently meet customers’ needs
Oversee the implementation of targeted programs and marketing activities, monitor progress and raise recommendations as and when necessary
Evaluate current business processes, identify opportunities for improvement and implement procedures maximizing efficiency and standardization
Put available systems into practice (salesforce.com CRM for leads, opportunity and deal registration management) for output efficiency and standardization
Lead and coach the team cultivating empowerment and ownership
Develop capabilities and secure a solid succession plan
Conduct regular performance reviews, identify training needs and oversee development plans.
